description: This file defines the PersistableManufacturerPopulator class, which is responsible for converting PersistableManufacturer objects into Manufacturer objects within the SalesManager project. It primarily populates manufacturer details including descriptions, language settings, and merchant store information.

classes.name: PersistableManufacturerPopulator
classes.description: A populator class used to convert PersistableManufacturer data transfer objects into Manufacturer domain objects, including setting descriptions and language information.

methods.name: populate
methods.description: Converts a PersistableManufacturer instance into a Manufacturer object, populating descriptions and language details, and associating it with a MerchantStore.

methods.name: createTarget
methods.description: Placeholder method for creating a new Manufacturer instance; currently returns null.

methods.name: setLanguageService
methods.description: Setter for injecting the LanguageService dependency.

methods.name: getLanguageService
methods.description: Getter for retrieving the current LanguageService instance.
